value.description: Neo-grotesque sans, light to regular weight, sentence case, single line, centred (journey line left-anchored at x ≈ 0.12). Line box height 0.09–0.13 of frame height; line width 0.37–0.76 of frame width. White on the green, cloud and aerial grounds. Font inferred: a light grotesque in the family of Inter or Neue Haas Grotesk.

Two voices on one centred line at y ≈ 0.46: lead phrase in the same light sans, value word in an italic transitional serif at the same size; line box height 0.08–0.11 of frame height, width 0.26–0.54. White over photo plates; dark grey lead and brand-green (#3b7755) italic on the final white plate.
Italic serif wordmark, centred, about 0.15 of frame width and 0.10 of height at the close; white over the opening photo plate, near-black #1b1b1b on white at the close.
Small light sans line under the wordmark at y ≈ 0.85, width 0.17 of frame, box height 0.035; grey on white.
The product's own UI type inside captures: small serif-headed panel titles with sans body; never re-set by the film.

composition.value: Everything that carries a message sits on the horizontal centre band (y 0.44–0.47 of height). Type is small for a commercial — lines are 0.09–0.13 of frame height and never fill more than 0.76 of the width — so plates and objects carry the frame and the type reads as a caption over them. Objects are centred: the slab at about 40% of width, the button about 25–30%, the phone rising to fill about 25% of width from the bottom edge, the sphere about 45% of height. The interface is framed whole with 10–15% margins, then the camera moves in. Headlines above a device sit at y ≈ 0.11–0.22.

materials.value: Three families: (1) flat brand grounds with thin line art (ring figure, particle-stroke sphere) in muted green; (2) a photoreal brushed-metal product object in green and silver, with specular sweeps and soft shadows on a warm off-white sweep; (3) graded stock plates (architecture, clouds, aerial cities, fence, clock, light trails, golden hour, skyline) and the real product interface on white with small 3D-rendered illustrations.

lighting.value: Studio key from top-left on the metal object with a moving specular band; a soft diagonal sheen crosses the shrinking slab; plates are bright daylight except the storm clouds, the clock interior and the night traffic, which supply the only dark moments outside the brand green.

styleSummary: Quiet premium fintech: deep green, warm off-white and white grounds; light sans with an italic serif accent; one photoreal metal product object; a calm first half of transforming shapes and rising sheets, then a faster second half of hard cuts and 1 s anthem plates.
